title: About
text: The Phantoms Hockey Hub is a small team website for keeping the season organized. It brings live SportNinja data, team reminders, and contact information into a clean documentation-style site.

title: About
text:
Site Goals


Centralize
Keep schedule, standings, statistics, and recurring team notes in one place.


Clarify
Make the next useful action obvious for families checking the site from a phone.


Preserve
Keep a simple season history as information changes over time.

title: Season
text:
Quick Reminders






Rink Address: The Sports Arena Rink: 620 Middle Country Rd, St James, New York, 11780, United States





Game Day
On game day here are a few things everyone should do:

Arrive 15 to 20 minutes early. This allows your player to get ready, and have a pre-game pep and strategy talk.
Make sure you have your jersey, stick, protection and water.
Come ready as if you are playing for the cup.



Practice
We are going to be at the park again this Saturday for Practice, if you can join we’d love to have you. Bring your stick, protection and water.
When: This Saturday May 23rd, 2026 (Weather permitting)
Time: Noon
Location: (correct this time) 12 Pines Park on Southaven Ave, Medford
Google Maps Link: https://maps.app.goo.gl/ByVGqeR72tDojN4q6


Updates
We have a new player coming to our team. His name is Parker and he will be our team goalie. Please make sure you say hello and make him feel welcome!
